metadata.dcterms:title: The Quantum G_2 Link Invariant
metadata.dcterms:creator: October 7, 1991
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We derive an inductive, combinatorial deﬁnition of a polynomial-valued regular isotopy invariant of links and tangled graphs. We show that the invariant equals the Reshetikhin-Turaev invariant corre- sponding to the exceptional simple Lie algebra G2. It is therefore related to G2 in the same way that the HOMFLY polynomial is related to An and the Kauﬀman polynomial is related to Bn, Cn, and Dn. We give parallel constructions for the other rank 2 Lie algebras and present some combinatorial conjectures motivated by the new inductive deﬁnitions. This paper is divided into two parts. In the ﬁrst part we derive from ﬁrst principles some variants of the link invariant known as the Jones polynomial. In the second part we show that these invariants are the same known invariants constructed using rank 2 Lie algebras, and we discuss some of their properties. Invariants of links and graphs The simplest known deﬁnition of the Jones polynomial is the Kauﬀman bracket [8], which in this paper will be denoted by ⟨·⟩A1 and will be called the A1 bracket.
